attributes.board_name: Louisiana Licensed Professional Counselors Board of Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops/presentations approved by AAMFT (and regional/state divisions incl. LAMFT) or Louisiana Counseling Association; graduate coursework; other CE reviewed by the advisory committee at renewal (no pre-approval).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Accrual begins after the license issue date.

topics.who: Ethics specific to marriage and family therapy (generic ethics not accepted)
Social and cultural competence, per renewal beginning 2027 (board page)
Board-approved supervisors (LMFT-S): clinical MFT supervision every 4 years
Licensees previously approved to practice telehealth

rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LX, §3503
rules.notes: Renewal every two years in December (deadline December 31). Also 6 hours in DSM diagnosis (no topic code). Max 20 CEH online (except accredited coursework). Dual licensees: 20 of 40 hours must be MFT-specific.

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by AAMFT (and divisions incl. LAMFT) or Louisiana Counseling Association (see §3315).
